Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Just to insist: Toreador and Toreador antitribu are considered to be totally different clans.
And this is true for all clans having an antitribu counterpart.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Correct answers from TheLasombra and Ankha.
"Toreador" and "Toreador Antitribu" are as different as "Brujah" and "True Brujah" are. Or "Malkavian" and "Ahrimanes".

Messages.Author: Gangrel-Boy
Messages.Body:
